title: Capture the mcp-gateway SBOM and image record into applications/mcp-gateway/images
description:
Download the mcp-gateway-sbom-<version> artefact from the first release run after task 1 (`gh run download <run-id> -n mcp-gateway-sbom-<version>`). If no release is cut before this task's due date, generate the SBOM for the image digest currently deployed in prod through `node .claude/scripts/toolchain/scan.mjs` with the pinned syft 1.51.1 instead. Never call syft directly.
Create applications/mcp-gateway/images/mongodb-mcp-server.cdx.json from that SBOM. Add the metadata.properties entries maxwell:runId, maxwell:sessionId, maxwell:workflow and maxwell:imageId=mongodb-mcp-server that application/sbom-ref.schema.json requires.
Create applications/mcp-gateway/images/mongodb-mcp-server.json (kind maxwell.app.image) with:
- ref: docker.io/<vars.DOCKERHUB_IMAGE_REPOSITORY>:<version>@sha256:<digest>
- registry: docker.io
- repository and digest taken from image-digest.txt
- builtFrom: repoId mongodb-mcp-server, the release commit and dockerfilePath Dockerfile
- sbomPath: applications/mcp-gateway/images/mongodb-mcp-server.cdx.json
- envIds: the mcp-gateway environments (dev, qa, prod) that run this image
- provenance
Write only inside the layout-sanctioned images/ path and never copy registry credentials.
acceptanceCriteria: The digest in mongodb-mcp-server.json equals the image-digest.txt of the captured release run (or the prod-deployed digest in the fallback case) and the metadata.component version in mongodb-mcp-server.cdx.json
mongodb-mcp-server.json sbomPath resolves to the existing .cdx.json file, and `find applications/mcp-gateway -iname '*.cdx.json'` returns exactly that path

verificationMethod.description: Run `node .claude/scripts/validate-data.mjs` on both image files (expected exit 0). Compare the digest in the image record, the SBOM metadata.component version and the release run's image-digest.txt (expected: all three identical). Confirm the SBOM lists npm components with purls and hashes from the package.json/pnpm lockfile.

rootCause.description: No procedure or owner copies the SBOM produced at release into applications/mcp-gateway/images/, so the workspace has no image record or SBOM for mcp-gateway at all.
